‘KALBARYO 2026’

LOOK: Rev. Fr. Marti Sandino Espenido distributes Holy Communion during a Mass at the NIA Road settlement area in Quezon City on Holy Tuesday, March 31, weeks after a massive fire gutted the community.

Urban poor groups, NGO representatives, and church-based organizations launched "Kalbaryo 2026,” an annual Lenten mobilization that reimagines the traditional "Way of the Cross" as a powerful expression of the urban poor's struggle against displacement, housing insecurity, and the lack of basic services. | 📷: Grig C. Montegrande, Philippine Daily Inquirer
